desc: Parse the input to extract N, M, and the list of colored cells.
Initialize arrays/maps for $LB$ and $UB$ for rows and columns, setting defaults to 0 and N respectively.
Update $LB$ and $UB$ based on the input cells (Black cells increase lower bounds, White cells decrease upper bounds).
Validate that $LB_r \leq UB_r$ and $LB_c \leq UB_c$ for all involved rows and columns.
Construct a sorted list of unique column indices that have constraints and compute the prefix minimum of their $UB$ values.
Construct a sorted list of unique row indices that have constraints and compute the prefix minimum of their $UB$ values.
Check Condition A: For every row $r$ with $LB_r > 0$, verify that the minimum $UB_c$ for all $c \leq LB_r$ is at least $r$.
Check Condition B: For every column $c$ with $LB_c > 0$, verify that the minimum $UB_r$ for all $r \leq LB_c$ is at least $c$.
Run the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
If any sample fails, debug the logic (specifically the boundary conditions or the prefix min construction).
Once verified, the solution is complete.
